summary.short: Directs the Secretary of Commerce, within 90 days, to establish the American AI Exports Program for full-stack American AI export packages, soliciting industry-led consortia proposals. Directs the Secretary of State to coordinate Federal financing tools through the EDAG for priority packages. Dated July 23, 2025.
summary.long: Executive Order 14320 of July 23, 2025 directs the Secretary of Commerce, within 90 days, to establish the American AI Exports Program to support United States full-stack AI export packages. The Secretary must issue a public call for industry-led consortium proposals. Each proposal must include a full-stack package (AI-optimized hardware, data pipelines, AI models and systems, cybersecurity measures and use-case applications), target countries or regional blocs, a high-level data-center business model, requested Federal incentives, and compliance with export control and outbound investment rules. Proposals are due within 90 days of the call and considered on a rolling basis. Selected proposals are designated priority AI export packages with priority access to Federal financing tools. Section 4 makes the Secretary of State responsible for a unified export strategy and for coordinating the Economic Diplomacy Action Group (EDAG), whose members the SBA and OSTP may appoint. Listed financing tools, used to the maximum extent permitted by law, include direct and guaranteed loans, equity investments, political risk insurance and technical assistance. Implementation is subject to applicable law and appropriations, and the order creates no enforceable rights. The order sets no penalties.

notes: The text is an executive order with no penalty, enforcement or private-right provisions. Sec. 5(c) disclaims enforceable rights. Operative duties are subject to applicable law and appropriations (Sec. 5(b)). The document gives no dates beyond the 90-day periods in Sec. 3(a) and Sec. 3(c). Relations list only instruments cited in the text, with no registry IDs. The Sec. 4(a) reference to section 708 and the Sec. 4(b) delegation under section 708(c)(3) are coded as one designates_under row. Entity LEI and ticker fields are left null.

thresholds.note: No numeric cutoff in the order changes legal treatment of any person or entity. The 90-day periods in Sec. 3(a) and Sec. 3(c) are procedural deadlines (events), and the order states no penalty amounts, eligibility limits or price tiers. The loan and financing authorities in Sec. 4(d) cite statutes without amounts.

enforcement.note: The order sets up the American AI Exports Program and directs agencies to coordinate federal financing tools. It states no fines, penalties, licence revocations, clawbacks, suspensions or blocking. Sec. 5(c) states that it creates no enforceable right or benefit. Proposal duties in Sec. 3(b)(v) require compliance with export control regimes but do not attach a sanction in this text.
